entries.note: Do not confuse صِدْق with صِدِّيق
Distinct gemination and long ī; do not pronounce as Ṣidq
This is the sūrah name, not a synthetic recitation of Quran verses
Do not speak source numbers as part of the sacred text
Not to be mixed with actual verse recitation
Never voice the ligature as an acronym
